name: Sky Ladder
design_intent:
SKY LADDER — THE HIGH WIRE #17 (tier 3, vertical ascent, open top, deep drop). Five spring-heavy tiers zigzag UP a narrow dusk shaft, each 520px above the last, over a DEEP void, with non-lethal bumper side walls that ricochet a wide shot back into the climb. NO lethal lid — the top is open, so the danger is entirely the long fall below. A pure verticality stage: the fight is the climb, and knocking a rival off any tier drops them the whole ladder. kill_shape = void_is_floor. Signature: the circuit's ascent shape without a lid (the_summit adds the lethal lid; the ridges/spires are horizontal). Feel = 'race up the zigzag ladder; knock them off a rung and they fall the whole sky.'

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; drift ~527 spring MAX; normal_boost_max 760, super 2800 rises ~2450). Tiers zigzag left/right: T1 x-500..300 top1400 (trampoline base) / T2 x400..1000 top880 / T3 x-1000..-400 top360 / T4 x400..1000 top-160 / T5 x-700..100 top-680 (all spring), each ~520px above the last; bumper walls x-1280 and x1180 (h2150):
- CLIMB T1->T2->T3->T4->T5: each rung is a 520px vertical climb to a tier offset ~100-700px horizontally (a zigzag boost up-and-over). Spring apex 480 falls 40px short of the 520 rise, and the target tier is offset sideways, so no bounce completes a rung. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED on every rung; an under-shot drops back down the shaft. Verb: FLY. (Rule B, >= 520.)
- BUMPER WALLS: the two side walls are non-lethal reflectors (tier bumper, restitution ~0.86) that bounce an over-boosted climber back into the shaft and refund fuel — they shape the column, they never kill. The kill is the fall past the bottom.
- RECOVER: T1 bottom 1528 -> bottom blast line 2328 = 800px of open sky (>= 650, Rule D); a knock off an upper tier is a long, hard recovery down the shaft. Verb: FLY.
- OPEN TOP: bounds top -3330 (far above T5) so a straight-up super/knock simply arcs back — no lethal lid; up is safe, down kills. No bounce completes any rung, so the jetpack is required to move at all. Vertical distance IS the level.
